new_statements.quote: Sur ce gabarit restreint se joue un eventail d'articulations secondaires : toutes les varietes ont entre trois et cinq tons basiques avec des tons melodiques, la nasalisation et la phonation non-modale. [...] CVh est note en I-Sochiapan et Lalana, Lacova, Petlapa, Teotalcingo, Rio Chiquito, et La Alicia, une serie de localites de la variete IV, les memes localites ayant la balisticite. En suivant l'analyse de Herrera (2000), la frication glottale finale n'est autre que la balisticite ce qui permet de la traiter non comme un segment plein mais comme une realisation de ce contraste au niveau syllabique, la balisticite. [fn. 8:] Pour rappel : Usila et Sochiapan (variete I) ; Palantla et Tepetotutla (variete II), toutes les localites de la variete IV ; et Quiotepec et Comaltepec (variete V).
new_statements.translation: On this restricted template a range of secondary articulations is played out: all the varieties have between three and five basic tones with contour tones, nasalisation and non-modal phonation. [...] CVh is noted in I-Sochiapan and Lalana, Lacova, Petlapa, Teotalcingo, Rio Chiquito and La Alicia, a series of variety-IV localities, the same localities that have ballisticity. Following Herrera (2000), final glottal frication is nothing other than ballisticity, which allows it to be treated not as a full segment but as a realisation of this syllable-level contrast, ballisticity. [fn. 8:] As a reminder [localities with ballisticity]: Usila and Sochiapan (variety I); Palantla and Tepetotutla (variety II), all the localities of variety IV; and Quiotepec and Comaltepec (variety V).

new_statements.second_reader_evidence: statement check: group-level-statement. Diasystem-level sentence ('toutes les varietes ont entre trois et cinq tons') second-hand from Rensch 1968 notation; Petlapa/Teotalcingo (variety IV) are named only for CVh/ballisticity, and Rensch himself lacked a tone analysis for them. No Tepinapa-specific tone count, nothing on stress. | checker: The saved PDF is not yet in the mirror dir, but A's extracted text extract is on (work_2026-09-20/disc/tepi1241/) and I checked the passages there: lines 254-258 'Sur ce gabarit restreint se joue un eventail d'articulations secondaires : toutes les varietes ont entre trois et cinq tons basiques avec des tons melodiques,[fn4] la nasalisation et la phonatio…
new_statements.relation_note: Family/diasystem-level: 3-5 basic tones in all varieties; ballisticity (a laryngeal syllable-level contrast 'lie a l'accent') attested in all variety-IV localities incl. Petlapa and Teotalcingo; discusses Mugele 1984 on Lalana ballistic stress.
new_statements.rule_in_words: All Chinantec dialect groups, including variety IV to which Petlapa and Teotalcingo (Tepinapa-area) belong, are tonal with three to five level tones plus contours; Petlapa and Teotalcingo forms in Rensch's data show CVh, read as ballistic (vs controlled) syllables. Nothing on the position of word stress.
new_statements.exceptions: fn. 4: tones for Tepetotutla, Ozumacin, Villa Nacional, Latani, Lealao and Yolox are not given in Rensch 1968 (Petlapa/Teotalcingo not in that list, but Rensch 1968 sec. 1.14 itself says no tone analysis was available for them -- unresolved); author warns the age/nature of the data do not permit fine-grained phonetic analysis and that the ballisticity list is 'provisoire'.
new_statements.identity_note: Diasystemic (structural-dialectology) re-analysis of Rensch 1968's 194-cognate x 23-locality data (MAmP digital corpus); Petlapa and Teotalcingo (Tepinapa-area / 'sureste medio' towns, see works[0]) are among the 18 second-tier localities and are placed in 'variete IV, basses terres meridionales' with Lalana, Lealao, Latani, Lacova, Rio Chiquito, La Alicia. Statements about Petlapa/Teotalcingo are second-hand readings of Rensch's notation, not new fieldwork.
